fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Detached Structure; Walkway
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Multiple Structures; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Install a reflective address sign at the street to help responders locate the property quickly when approaching from either direction.
• Keep the area around the single driveway entrance clear of parked vehicles so responding units can enter and exit without obstruction.
• Mark or label the detached structure on any posted site map or address placard so responders arriving on scene know multiple structures are present.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear to allow responders to move quickly between buildings.
• Post the address visibly on both the main residence and the detached structure so responders can confirm which building they are working at.
• If a gate or barrier limits rear access, keep it unlocked or install a knox-box style lock to allow emergency responders through without delay.
• Identify and mark any alternate foot path to the rear of the property so responders are not limited to a single approach route.
